notes: Replaces the multi-wrap Batch Split with a true drop-in component. The new BatchSplitDropIn.ps1 is self-contained for batch image loading, panel creation, persistent per-cover state, guide painting/dragging, cropping, and saving. The main Library script only receives a small startup hook and the old batch button is replaced, while the existing single-cover splitter and the rest of The Library remain untouched. Validation passed with five simultaneous PNG cover panels, live paint/guide events, and 15 saved split-piece records.
